verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents LLM-driven structured extraction. You add a `json` format with a prompt and schema to the scrape endpoint and get structured JSON back without CSS/XPath selectors (firecrawl-docs-16, firecrawl-gh-7, firecrawl-docs-1). Its agent mode also retrieves data from a natural-language description of what you need (firecrawl-gh-1). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of schema-less extraction where the LLM itself chooses the fields, in-depth documentation of extraction accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
